intent_en: Show that the General Motors CEO received unusually high compensation in 2018 compared with her counterparts at Volkswagen and Toyota.
narration_support: You can see what a uniquely American phenomenon this is when you compare the compensation for General Motors CEO with her counterparts at Volkswagen in Germany and Toyota in Japan. And you can see part of the reason for this gap when you look at how much of their profits these people have earned.
